name: gimytw.cc
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But plain http serves the site without redirecting.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with one permanent 301, then add HSTS.
summary: The site's bot protection refused the plain request; the page was analyzed in headless Chrome. Partial analysis: 19 of 19 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. gimytw.cc scores 64 out of 100 (D). 7 checks fail now, 25 are at risk, and 21 pass. Fix first: plain http serves the site without redirecting.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 403. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 57 elements on /, for example .active > a[href="/"] and .text-muted[href$="latest/"][title="更多"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: 6 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
The start page declares its language
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
Every page has a meta description
The start page sets a mobile viewport
